raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19) delivers `amount` with a leading '$' (e.g. '$14.09'), which DuckDB cannot cast directly to DECIMAL(12,2). Other batches are plain numeric strings, and the currency is USD throughout, so stripping the '$' prefix before the cast recovers the intended value without changing any other logic.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(amount, '$', '')) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
